items.label: 25-In-1 Construction Truck Toy Set With Carrier
items.value: Includes 12 mini construction trucks and 12 worker figures stored in a large carrier truck. A complete construction toys set featuring excavator, dump truck, bulldozer and more, ideal for kids who love toy trucks and building play

items.label: Realistic Sound And Light Effects For Interactive Play
items.value: Press the roof buttons to activate sound effects, music, and flashing lights. Some toy cars feature movable parts for a more lifelike experience, making this a fun and engaging car toys set for toddlers and kids

items.label: Enhances Creativity And Hands-On Learning
items.value: Kids can enjoy construction play by using excavators to dig and trucks to move sand. Made with Alloy metal and durable ABS plastic, these toy trucks support fine motor skills and interactive indoor and outdoor play, including sandbox fun

items.label: Boosts Imagination And Creative Role Play
items.value: Kids can create their own construction site, using excavator toys to dig or trucks to transport sand. This construction toy set helps develop creativity, fine motor skills, and storytelling during pretend role play activities

items.label: Great Gift For Toddlers And Kids Age 3+
items.value: A fun choice for birthdays or everyday surprises, ideal for boys and girls who enjoy construction toys and truck play. Suitable for kids toys boys 3-5, toys for 4 year old boys, and children ages 3 and up

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 carrier truck, 12 mini construction trucks, figures
